snippet.title: Novanoom | Gameplay Trailer | Fight, Craft, Unlock the World
snippet.description:
The planet does not open on its own.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4847330/Novanoom

Explore alien biomes, fight in real time, collect drops and Novanoom crystals,
and craft tools that unlock new paths.

Explore, fight, craft, open the world, survive to the save point, beat the boss.

Discord: https://novanoom.com/discord
Press and business: radu@wavemyth.com
Made in Unity by Wavemyth. PC first, on Steam.

#Novanoom #IndieGame #Gameplay #ActionAdventure #SciFi
